initialPlanPrompt:
Survey the codebase, then reply with a markdown checklist (`- [ ] …`) of ordered milestones, each completable in one iteration. Optional per item: `— verify: <command>`. Planning only — no implementation. The host stores milestones in agent runtime data and injects the next one each iteration.

Goal: {{goal}}

steps.prompt:
Evaluate progress. Do not edit any files — the host updates the plan checklist from your DONE line. If the goal is fully achieved, output a line exactly: `{{completionMarker}}: true`
Otherwise reply in at most 150 words using exactly this shape:
DONE: <what changed this iteration>
REMAINING: <what is left>
NEXT: <the single next change>
FILES TOUCHED: <comma-separated paths>

Goal: {{goal}}
Iteration: {{iteration}}
